text:
alex: heads-up — after the routing weight change, console p95/p99 for /v1/generate spiked but p50 stayed flat. feels like sample-origin flip. anyone else seeing this? (i attached a quick screenshot)
maria: yep saw it. p99 up ~250ms cluster-wide. endpoint sample counts for that route dropped ~30% in the last 10m. could be fallback to slower variant triggering tail
jonathan: can you paste the query link? are we looking at rollup-derived percentiles or raw samples?
alex: quick links: raw query: /dash/query?e=/v1/generate&from=now-30m ; rollup view shows the same shape. my hypothesis: weighted-merge changed and a small cohort with high latency now dominates p99
sophie: we should surface "sample provenance" next to percentile values. current console hides whether p99 is coming from a tiny cohort vs many clients
jonathan: +1. proposal: add a lightweight "latency stratifier" row that breaks p50/p95/p99 by route variant / client cohort and shows sample_count + effective_weight. example display: p99 -> 420ms (count=12, eff_weight=0.03)
alex: also backend change: include telemetry.sample_origin and telemetry.sample_weight in aggregation events. minimal event shape sketch:
```json
{ "endpoint": "/v1/generate", "latency_ms": 402, "percentile": 99, "sample_origin": "rollup:route=variant-b", "sample_weight": 0.083 }
```
maria: love that. UX-wise we should gray/highlight percentiles when sample_count < 50 and show a warning tooltip: "low sample support — percentile unstable"
sophie: tooltip text idea: "This percentile is computed from X samples (effective weight Y). Click to inspect representative traces or top N contributors."
rollouts-bot: deploy started: routing-weight-adjust v1.2 -> canary 10% (rollout id r-2026-173905)
jonathan: ops question — if we add sample_origin as a field, will that blow up cardinality in our metrics store? worried about too many origin tags in rollups
alex: sample_origin should be an enum with limited values (raw, rollup, fallback, cache-hit, variant). sample_weight is numeric and not a tag. we only attach sample_origin to the telemetry payload (not as metric tag) and expose it in debug APIs and console logic
sophie: we should also add a debug endpoint: /internal/debug/percentile-samples?endpoint=/v1/generate&percentile=99&since=1h which returns representative sample traces (authenticated + rate-limited)
maria: agree — restrict to dedicated/private clusters by default, add RBAC and per-team rate limits
alex: ok i'll draft a backend PR to (1) emit sample_origin & sample_weight, (2) compute effective weighted-count per-percentile, and (3) surface a small samples API. sophie can mock the console strip and tooltip. jonathan can scope infra/storage impact and quota changes
jonathan: noted. i'll run a quick impact calc on storage and propose a quota bump for internal debug endpoints if needed. ping me with estimated event volume
sophie: UX note: keep the main view compact — show stratifier collapsed by default with a chevron, expand to see per-variant breakdown. also include a tiny sparklines-per-cohort
alex: assigning owners: alex/backend, sophie/ux, jonathan/infra. timeline: rough prototype in 1 week. will open design RFC + backend PR
jonathan: sounds good. i'll follow up with a storage estimate tomorrow morning. @channel if anyone has reason not to proceed please flag now :thumbsup:
